name: py-run
description: Execute a Python snippet or script in the repo venv (uv run) or system python3 (--system). Returns JSON {exit, stdout, stderr, duration_ms}. For a stateful REPL use proc: start 'python3 -i' then write.
use_when: running a Python snippet or script file
run: python3 tools/py-run/py_run.py [-c CODE | script.py] [script args...] [--cwd DIR] [--timeout S] [--system]

args.name: target
args.description: Script path, or code when -c is given.

args.name: --system
args.description: Use system python3 instead of the repo venv.

dependencies: uv (for repo venv; falls back to python3)
stdout: JSON {exit, stdout, stderr, duration_ms, truncated, interpreter}.
